Q5278.reason: Burglary requires a trespassory entry which cannot exist if the door was unlocked and entered openly without force or deception.

Q8324.reason: Severe agitation and aggression often indicate neurodegenerative damage (cell death) in dopamine-rich areas like the substantia nigra or striatum.
